dashboard.title: AI-Powered Real Estate Business Automation
dashboard.welcome: The start of your development! You are ready to soar as a developer.
dashboard.description: At this stage the focus is locale routing, base layouts, dashboard structure, and placeholder pages. Real API connections can be added once backend contracts are stable.
dashboard.summaryDesign: The structure now has a clear slot for AI design and floor-plan generation.
dashboard.summaryFinance: Finance analysis and tax calculation views are separated into modules.
dashboard.summaryBlockchain: The escrow screen and contract integration area are reserved in advance.

auth.loginDescription: The routing and entry structure are fixed before real OAuth and JWT integration.

auth.registerDescription: The base layout is prepared first so the same signup flow can be reused across locales.
auth.registerPlaceholder: User type, tenant connection, and policy flow will be wired after the API contract is finalized.

projects.description: Search, state filters, and recent activity shortcuts will be attached here.

bim.title: IFC quantities and 3D viewer
bim.description: This space is reserved for a Three.js BIM viewer and quantity table.

drone.description: This view is prepared for inspection history, risk distribution, and urgent alert state.

inspection.title: AI-powered field inspection automation
inspection.description: This screen prepares the PWA offline flow and on-site inspection checklist.

sre.title: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
sre.description: Real-time monitoring of infrastructure, build quality, and service health for Sa-Tong-Pal-Ttang.

feasibility_simulation.title: Financial Sensitivity Simulation
feasibility_simulation.description: Adjust economic variables to predict probabilistic ROI/NPV outcomes.

approvalCenter.title: Approval operations center
approvalCenter.description: Operate pending approvals, tenant-wide audit filters, rationale review, and project-scoped batch decisions from one live workspace.

items.first: Tenant-wide approval queue and resolved decisions
items.third: Project-scoped bulk approve and reject actions

approvalCenter.projectContextDesc: Choose a live project or pin an existing UUID when the audit scope should stay project-specific.
approvalCenter.auditFiltersDesc: Switch between active-project and tenant-wide views, then narrow the queue by status or approver role.
approvalCenter.apiAuthRequired: API authentication is required for live approval operations.
approvalCenter.realProjectRequired: A real project UUID is required for project-scoped approval actions.

workspace.connectionTitle: Data connection and mock adapter status
workspace.emptyStateDescription: Create or sync a project to populate the live portfolio view.
workspace.errorStateDescription: The live project list could not be loaded. Check the API connection and try again.

pwa.title: Offline shell, install prompt, and push baseline
pwa.description: Register the service worker, keep the dashboard shell available offline, install the workspace on field devices, and validate notification permission before live web-push binding.
pwa.updateDescription: Apply the waiting service worker to reload the shell with the latest offline assets.
pwa.testNotificationBody: The offline workspace is ready for inspection and field reporting.

lifecycle.title: Deep Integration View
lifecycle.pendingDesc: The deep integration view for this stage is scheduled in the next phase of the 168-table DB rollout.

cadBim.title: Design AI Integration
cadBim.description: Auto-generated CAD proposals and interactive 3D BIM models based on Sa-Tong-Pal-Ttang core engine.

feasibility.title: Monte Carlo Feasibility Simulation
feasibility.description: Run 10,000+ iteration simulations for probabilistic ROI and NPV modeling.

feasibilityV2.title: Feasibility Analysis v2
feasibilityV2.subtitle: 15 dev types x 28 tax/charge/fee codes, automated

cost.title: Construction Cost QTO
cost.description: Automated Quantity Takeoff linked to 3D BIM and real-time material price indices.

schedule.title: Schedule & AI Supervision
schedule.description: Automated Gantt generation and real-time site inspection compliance monitoring.

maintenance.title: Digital Twin Maintenance
maintenance.description: Enter equipment readings to get a rough maintenance priority estimate. Live sensor integration and the server-side prediction model are not connected yet.
items: · Rough anomaly score from your inputs — computed in the browser
· Equipment IoT sensor live feed — not connected
· Predictive maintenance model (server) — not connected

projects.title: Project Pipeline
projects.description: Monitors combined progress across every development project you have access to.
items: · Project list and progress stages — server connected
· Next-action link per project — shown on the card
· Security compliance verdict — not connected

contracts.title: Electronic Contract Management
contracts.description: Manages service, award and lease contracts, and tracks their status.
items: · Contract drafting and lookup — server connected
· E-signature — one-way two-state flow (mock provider)
· Security compliance verdict — not connected

legal.title: Legal & Ordinance Review
legal.description: Analyses the zoning of the given parcel and checks it against current building and environmental regulations.
items: · Cadastre, zoning, and land-use plan lookup — VWorld connected
· Building Act rule check and local ordinances — live MOLEG API lookup
· Multi-regulation list and hierarchy — map overlay not connected

finance.title: Finance Analysis
finance.description: Check AVM valuation from nearby transactions and jeonse deposit risk. PF structuring, equity simulation, and repayment schedules are not connected yet.
items: · AVM valuation and jeonse deposit risk — server connected
· Next-stage routing — driven by the lifecycle source of truth
· Security compliance verdict — not connected

feasibility.title: Feasibility Analysis
feasibility.description: Automatically computes 15 development types and 28 tax/charge/fee codes. Local ordinances are looked up and applied; when unavailable, the statutory ceiling is used and disclosed as degraded.
items: · Feasibility simulation across 15 development types — server connected
· Tax and financing cost auto-calculation — server connected
· ROI and confidence scoring — break-even point not calculated

report.title: Final Feasibility Report
report.description: Summarises the accumulated legal, design and feasibility results into a PDF and dashboard report.
items: · Investor and bank-ready report generation — server connected
· Next-stage routing — driven by the lifecycle source of truth
· Security compliance verdict — not connected

site-analysis.title: Site & Environment Analysis
site-analysis.description: Reads terrain, daylight, noise and surrounding infrastructure on a GIS basis.
items: · Zoning and comprehensive site analysis — server connected
· Next-stage routing — driven by the lifecycle source of truth
· Security compliance verdict — not connected

esg.title: ESG Metrics
esg.description: Tracks the project's non-financial value against EU Taxonomy and green building certification requirements.
items: · RE100 tracking and LCA carbon accounting — server connected
· EU Taxonomy eligibility — fixed-threshold rules (not AI)
· Green building certification — user-entered; G-SEED preliminary score not connected

bim.title: BIM Quantity Take-off
bim.description: Automatically takes off and maps 3D quantities — structure, finishes and more — from the generated IFC file.
items: · Quantities re-measured from generated IFC — volume, area, element count
· Generated on the IFC4 schema — conformance validator not connected
· Unit weight / unit price mapping per element — not connected (work-type codes only)

construction.title: Construction Schedule & Cost
construction.description: Estimates the schedule from standard durations and records progress billing and costs. 4D clash checking and live site IoT integration are not connected yet.
items: · Schedule estimated from standard durations — derived from GFA and floors (4D clash check not connected)
· Progress billing — entered manually (site IoT sensors not connected)
· Supply-chain risk tracking — not connected (fixed risk entries only)

permit.title: Permit Automation
permit.description: Checks the document list required for a building permit and assists the administrative workflow.
items: · Permit feasibility analysis and Building Act check — server connected
· Seumteo (EAIS) e-filing integration — not connected (local rules only)
· Review-comment history and official-document summaries — not connected

operations.title: Asset Operations (FM)
operations.description: Post-completion operations view. The metrics shown are fixed sample values; live BEMS and tenant-experience data are not connected yet.
items: · Operations status metrics — fixed sample values (live data not connected)
· Energy efficiency (BEMS) tracking — not connected
· Tenant experience index (TX) — not connected

drone.title: Drone Site Inspection
drone.description: Detects defects in uploaded drone imagery. Orthomosaic mapping and 3D point-cloud processing are not connected yet.
items: · Image-based defect detection — external vision API
· Orthomosaic processing — not connected
· Earthwork volume scanning and thermal diagnostics — not connected

blockchain.title: Blockchain Escrow
blockchain.description: Creates and queries escrow smart contracts. Fractional (STO) ledgers and tokenized capital raising are not connected yet.
items: · Escrow smart contract — Polygon Amoy testnet, as of last query
· Fractional real-estate (STO) ledger — not connected
· ESG investment disclosure — not connected

design.title: AI Schematic Design
design.description: Generates alternative massing and floor plans within statutory limits. Parking and daylight are computed as constraints; objective-driven optimization search is not connected yet.
items: · Mass selection synced with the axonometric drawing — rendered in the browser
· Three massing options — defaults are predefined; AI analysis runs on demand
· Statutory parking and north-side daylight — constraint calculation (no optimization search)

market-insights.title: Market & Price Analysis
market-insights.description: Analyzes real estate market trends based on actual transaction prices, assessed land values, and regional supply-demand data.
items: · Transaction data — MOLIT API lookup (monthly filings, not streaming)
· Valuation from nearby transactions (AVM) — weighted average, not a forecast
· Regional supply-demand index — not connected
